name: voice-foundation
description: Guided mission, decision rules, and voice foundation for real estate agents.

interface.longDescription: Voice Foundation guides real estate agents through two conversations about their mission, decision rules, and written and spoken voice. It uses their own examples and reviewed answers to create a personal foundation, complete portable instructions, and a private writing skill. Start, write, and update workflows are included. File generation needs a host with code and file tools; PDF generation uses an optional library, with printable HTML when unavailable. Installing a generated personal skill may require a separate upload. No separate API key or Creative Authority server is required. The plugin adds no telemetry; the host platform processes and stores conversations and files under its own settings and policies.
